entities.title: Move the zazz OIDs to a registered enterprise number
entities.summary: The code-signing EKU and the grants extension OIDs sit under IANA's example enterprise number 32473 until a registered Private Enterprise Number replaces it.
entities.compromise: EKU_OID and GRANTS_OID use the arc 1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.7979, under the example enterprise number RFC 5612 reserves for documentation.
entities.cost: The example arc is not unique to zazz, and every certificate issued with these OIDs must be reissued once they change.
acceptanceCriteria: EKU_OID and GRANTS_OID are under a registered Private Enterprise Number.
The contracts record signature-envelope states the new OIDs.

origin.description: The comment on EKU_OID ("replace with a registered PEN"), repeated in the implementation status of macos/rust/zazzled/ZAZZ-PLAN.md.
